items.briefing:
There are no significant cybersecurity incidents or threats directly affecting Australian organisations to report today. The most relevant story for leadership is that security chiefs across Australia and the APAC region are reportedly more concerned about AI governance risks than their general staff, highlighting a gap in awareness at the workforce level. As AI tools become more common in workplaces, including training organisations, ensuring all staff understand acceptable use policies is increasingly important.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses any AI tools, take a moment today to check whether you know your workplace's policy on what information can and cannot be entered into them.

featured.title: Security chiefs more worried than staff over AI governance
featured.quote: Security leaders worry AI vendors may mishandle sensitive data as adoption accelerates across Australian organizations.
